title: GlideUI
description: Small mod that adds animations to the guis
body:
GlideUI is a client-side Fabric mod that adds smooth open/close animations to inventory-style GUIs (player inventory, chests, furnaces, anvils, and other container screens). It works automatically with modded GUIs and screens added by other mods, inspired by flow mod!

Features
Ease In / Ease Out animations when opening and closing GUIs, each with:
An easing type (Linear, Sine, Quad, Cubic, Quart, Quint, Expo, Circ, Back, Elastic, Bounce — In/Out/InOut variants).
An animation type (Expand Middle / Middle Left / Middle Right / Top / Bottom, Slide Left / Right / Up / Down).
A configurable duration in milliseconds.
Background tint — configurable color that fades in with the animation.
Background blur — configurable intensity (0–100%) that ramps in with the animation.
Compatibility controls — master toggle, toggle for modded GUIs, creative inventory, and a per-screen class blacklist (editable in the config file).
